info.name: QRGUARD API
info.description: QRGUARD backend API. /api/analyze/url, /message and /screenshot are implemented (screenshot needs Tesseract); /api/analyze/qr and /api/generate/qr validate input and return 501 until built. Run with: newman run QRGUARD.postman_collection.json --working-dir postman

item.name: URL analysis (DEMO / TEST DATA)
item.description: No request here makes the backend contact any website: none of these URLs is a link shortener, so redirects are not followed.

exec: pm.test('every indicator is explained', () => pm.response.json().indicators.forEach(i => { pm.expect(i.message).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(i).to.have.property('score_contribution'); }));

item.name: Scam message analysis (DEMO / TEST DATA)

pm.test('every indicator has a source and contribution', () => pm.response.json().indicators.forEach(i => { pm.expect(['message','link','threat_intelligence','combination']).to.include(i.source); pm.expect(i).to.have.property('score_contribution'); }));

item.name: Screenshot analysis (DEMO / TEST DATA)
item.description: Uses the synthetic images in postman/fixtures (run newman with --working-dir postman). Requires Tesseract on the server.

item.name: MALICIOUS: dark-mode JPEG, UPI PIN to receive

exec: pm.test('QR evidence has source qr', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().indicators.every(x => x.source === 'qr')).to.eql(true));

item.name: MALICIOUS: scam text in QR (message rules)
Health: TI providers listed without secrets

exec: pm.test('no API key material in response', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); ['Auth-Key','x-apikey','api_key','app_key','?key='].forEach(k => pm.expect(t).to.not.include(k)); });

item.name: MALICIOUS + VERIFIED: URL on the demo blocklist

exec: pm.test('score is 90 MALICIOUS', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.risk_score).to.eql(90); pm.expect(b.risk_level).to.eql('MALICIOUS'); });

pm.test('local feed listed it (demo coverage)', () => { const p = pm.response.json().threat_intel.providers[0]; pm.expect(p.provider).to.eql('local_feed'); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('listed'); pm.expect(p.limited_coverage).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('no API key material in response', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); ['Auth-Key','x-apikey','api_key','app_key','?key='].forEach(k => pm.expect(t).to.not.include(k)); });

item.name: Not listed never lowers the score (look-alike stays 60)

exec: pm.test('still MALICIOUS 60', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.risk_score).to.eql(60); pm.expect(b.risk_level).to.eql('MALICIOUS'); });
pm.test('external providers without keys are disabled', () => pm.response.json().threat_intel.providers.slice(1).forEach(p => pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('disabled')));
pm.test('honest note', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().threat_intel.note).to.include('does not mean a link is safe'));

item.name: History, reports, admin (DEMO: dev tokens, in-memory store)

exec: pm.test('two items, newest first', () => { const i = pm.response.json().items; pm.expect(i).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(i[0].input_type).to.eql('url'); });
pm.test('no message text, token or full URL stored', () => { const t = pm.response.text(); ['PMSECRET42','Dear customer','/login'].forEach(s => pm.expect(t).to.not.include(s)); });

pm.test('URL reduced to domain + hash', () => { const u = pm.response.json().items[0].target; pm.expect(u.domain).to.eql('secure-sbi-kyc-update.example'); pm.expect(u.url_hash).to.have.length(64); });
